name: fizz-level-studio

scripts.test:js: bun run --cwd packages/chrome test && bun run --cwd plugins/fizz-studio-settings test && bun run --cwd plugins/fizz-studio-host test && bun run --cwd apps/studio test
scripts.test:js:ci: bun run --cwd packages/chrome test:ci && bun run --cwd plugins/fizz-studio-settings test:ci && bun run --cwd plugins/fizz-studio-host test:ci && bun run --cwd apps/studio test:ci
